svg.text: BEST FOR: RESULTS AT A GLANCE
DYNAMIC TEMPLATE • MOVING ARROWS & LIVE PACKETS
Harness Upgrade Scorecard: Six Headline Metrics Before and After Deterministic Controls
Big numbers are the measured 'after'; sparklines interpolate from the measured 'before'. Each control ships in a Google Cloud and an open-source form.
Before: 42.0 s with serial reads and no prefix cache
IDEA-09 • Vertex KV cache or vLLM prefix cache • Cloud Trace / Langfuse spans
Before: $0.68 routing every step to the frontier model
IDEA-09 Flash/Argon cascade (ADK router or LiteLLM)
Before: 69.0% with 85 MCP schemas mounted every turn
IDEA-04 dynamic MCP router (pgvector / Qdrant index)
Before: 80 stale claims with text-only memory
Before: 38% of 'completed' tasks failed on first run
Before: 48 identical retries observed on a single 400
IDEA-01 loop breaker (Firestore or Redis window)
HOW THESE NUMBERS WERE MEASURED (AND HOW TO RE-MEASURE THEM ON ANY STACK)
Each metric compares identical task sets before and after a
single harness control; models and tools are held constant.
Latency, cost, and retry counts come from OpenTelemetry spans
exported to Cloud Trace, Langfuse, or Arize Phoenix;
Stale-claim numbers are published OpenWiki results; the other
five are reference-harness measurements — re-run before
Curated by Nitin Aggarwal • Google Cloud ADK + OpenHands Factory • Proprietary + Confidential
Sources: IDEA-01 • IDEA-03 • IDEA-04 • IDEA-07 • IDEA-09 • OpenTelemetry / Langfuse
